name: Sonner
summary: The toast library's own demo. Toasts arrive and stack on the browser's plain ease at 0.4s, transform, opacity and height moving together; one stack move ran at 0.5s. Restraint as a feature.

tiers.label: toast moving in the stack, longer variant

honestyNote: Measured with two opt-in clicks on the page's own demo buttons (Render a toast, then the first toast type), recorded in the raw file. Swipe-to-dismiss wasn't tried, so the swipe-out keyframes in the stylesheet aren't tiers.
notes: Every toast timing seen is the keyword ease. No custom curve at all.
Reduced motion cut movement from 8 events to 2. Small numbers from two clicks, so read it as a hint.
